question: Is there an ungated route to CTRP v2 per-concentration dose-response data, after the DepMap download API began serving a bot-verification page?
decision_rule_fixed_before_probing: An ungated, citable deposit carrying per-concentration dose/viability (not only summary AUC), with a verifiable integrity hash, compatible with the offline contract (fetch locally, commit only derivatives).

routes.evidence: serves a bot-verification page instead of the documented catalogue
both articles listed in full; neither holds a CTRP response-curve file, the Harmonized CTD^2 data being a separate deposit

routes.route: figshare, a CTD^2 deposit of its own
routes.evidence: DepMap release articles are on figshare; a Harmonized CTD^2 deposit was not found
host resolves and port 21 is open; /pub/ lists OCE, caARRAY, cacore, dctd, pdm -- OCG-DCC is absent from its own parent. A checked absence, not a failed filename guess.
HEAD against the file returns HTTP 200 with content-length 43118179, so ungated by probe rather than by the record's own label

open_route.title: CTRPv2
open_route.provenance: PharmacoSet generated by ORCESTRA (Haibe-Kains Lab) from the Broad CTD^2 Center's CTRP; cites Seashore-Ludlow 2015 and Rees 2016
not_measured: file contents -- it has not been downloaded or parsed here
whether its compound list covers the cytotoxic agents the chemotherapy arm needs
open_route.carries_per_dose_basis: documentation, not measurement: a PharmacoSet's sensitivity$raw is a 3-D array whose second dimension is doses and whose third has the two fixed entries Dose and Viability

detail: .rds is R serialization and a PharmacoSet is an S4 object
no R and no Rscript on the machine
pyreadr and rpy2 both absent, and neither is in requirements-lock.txt
pyreadr reads data frames and vectors rather than arbitrary S4, so it is unlikely to suffice even if pinned
remaining_blocker.decision_deferred: Adding R or an R bridge to the pinned environment is a decision about the dependency contract, not a side effect of a route probe.

verdict_unchanged: NO FITTED POTENCY. Nothing is fitted by locating a file.
